sloka: ततः स सचिवेभ्यः तु सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः ।शशंस परम उद्विग्नः पश्यन् तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥४-२-५॥
transliteration: tataḥ sa sacivebhyaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ ।śaśaṁsa parama udvignaḥ paśyan tau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥4-2-5॥

translations.english: Sugriva, lord of monkeys, extremely agitated at the sight of both Rama and Lakshmana, spoke to his minister:
